 Minister Mehta to chair high-level discussion on ‘climate change and health’ at COP31
 November 7, 2026 
 Kathmandu: Minister for Health and Food Safety, Nisha Mehta, will chair a high-level discussion at the annual UN climate summit, COP31, being held in Antalya, Turkey. 
 The discussion focuses on the impact of climate change on public health and the resilience of health systems. 
 The event, titled ‘Health at the Centre of Climate Action: A Global Perspective ‘, will be held at the Nepal Pavilion on November 9. It is being held in collaboration with the Ministry of Health and Food Safety, Ipas Nepal and the World Health Organisation (WHO) Nepal. 
 Representatives from various countries and international partners would exchange views on public health challenges caused by climate change, the impact of climate-induced disasters on healthcare delivery and the development of climate-resilient health systems, according to the Minister’s Secretariat. 
 Nepal has aimed at utilizing the COP31 to underscore the need for international cooperation, financial assistance and policy commitments.
